title: One Edit Distance
description: Determine if two strings are exactly one edit distance apart.
pseudocode:
1. If abs(len(s)-len(t)) > 1 return False
2. If len(s) > len(t) swap(s, t)
3. For i from 0 to len(s):
4.   If s[i] != t[i]:
5.     If len(s) == len(t) return s[i+1:] == t[i+1:]
6.     Return s[i:] == t[i+1:]
7. Return len(t) == len(s) + 1

steps.note: Check length difference: 'ab' vs 'acb'. Difference is 1. Proceed.
Ensure s is shorter or equal to t. s='ab', t='acb'.
Compare s[1] ('b') and t[1] ('c'). No match.
Lengths differ by 1, check if s[1:] == t[2:]. 'b' == 'b'. True.
